title: Complete PCR Workflow with Thermocycler
author: Opentrons
materials: Master Mix Distribution and DNA Transfer](./pcr_prep_part_2) * [Part

Thermocycler](./thermocycler) This protocol allows your robot to create a master mix solution using any reagents stored in a 2 mL Eppendorf tube rack or a 2 mL screwcap tube rack. The master mix will be created in well A1 of the trough. The ingredient information will be provided as a CSV file. See Additional Notes for more details. --- You will need: * [4-in-1 Tube Rack Set](https://shop.opentrons.com/collections/opentrons-tips/products/tube-rack-set-1) * [12-well Trough](https://www.usascientific.com/12-channel-automation-reservoir.aspx)
Upload your protocol into the OT App.

steps.title: Gather required labware
steps.instruction: Place a 4‑in‑1 tube rack (compatible with 2 mL Eppendorf or 2 mL screw‑cap tubes) and a 12‑well trough on the robot deck as shown in the deck map; the trough should occupy slot 3.

steps.title: Select pipettes
steps.instruction: Choose the appropriate pipette(s) in the OT App for the upcoming protocol.

steps.title: Prepare and upload CSV
steps.instruction: Create a CSV file that lists each reagent, its source location, and the volume to add to the master mix; then upload this master‑mix CSV to the OT App.

steps.title: Generate and download protocol
steps.instruction: Using the OT App, generate the protocol based on the uploaded CSV and download the resulting protocol file.

steps.title: Upload protocol to OT App
steps.instruction: Upload the downloaded protocol file back into the OT App.

steps.title: Set up deck
steps.instruction: Arrange all labware on the deck according to the provided deck map (e.g., place the 12‑well trough in slot 3, tube rack in its designated slot, tip racks, etc.).

steps.title: Calibrate labware and pipettes
steps.instruction: Run the calibration routine in the OT App to calibrate the labware, tip racks, and pipettes, following the support article if needed.

steps.title: Start the run
steps.instruction: Press “Run” in the OT App to begin the protocol.

steps.title: Transfer reagents to trough
steps.instruction: The robot will aspirate each reagent from its source tube in the 2 mL rack and dispense the specified volume into well A1 of the trough located in slot 3, forming the master mix.
